chapters.summary: The Philistine giant Goliath challenged Israel to single combat for forty days. David, a young shepherd, went out against him with a sling and five stones, struck him in the forehead, and killed him; the Philistines fled and Israel pursued them.

verses.kjv: And it came to pass, when he had made an end of speaking unto Saul, that the soul of Jonathan was knit with the soul of David, and Jonathan loved him as his own soul.
verses.modern: As soon as he had finished speaking to Saul, the soul of Jonathan was knit to the soul of David, and Jonathan loved him as his own soul.

verses.kjv: And Saul took him that day, and would let him go no more home to his father's house.
verses.modern: Saul took him that day and would not let him return to his father's house.

verses.kjv: Then Jonathan and David made a covenant, because he loved him as his own soul.
verses.modern: Then Jonathan made a covenant with David, because he loved him as his own soul.

verses.kjv: And Jonathan stripped himself of the robe that was upon him, and gave it to David, and his garments, even to his sword, and to his bow, and to his girdle.
verses.modern: Jonathan stripped himself of the robe that was on him and gave it to David. his armor, and even his sword and his bow and his belt.

verses.kjv: And David went out whithersoever Saul sent him, and behaved himself wisely: and Saul set him over the men of war, and he was accepted in the sight of all the people, and also in the sight of Saul's servants.
verses.modern: David went out and was successful wherever Saul sent him, so that Saul set him over the men of war. And this was good in the sight of all the people and also in the sight of Saul's servants.

verses.kjv: And it came to pass as they came, when David was returned from the slaughter of the Philistine, that the women came out of all cities of Israel, singing and dancing, to meet king Saul, with tabrets, with joy, and with instruments of musick.
verses.modern: As they were coming home, when David returned from striking down the Philistine, the women came out of all the cities of Israel, singing and dancing, to meet King Saul, with tambourines, with songs of joy, and with musical instruments.

verses.kjv: And the women answered one another as they played, and said, Saul hath slain his thousands, and David his ten thousands.
verses.modern: The women sang to one another as they celebrated, "Saul has struck down his thousands, and David his ten thousands."

verses.kjv: And Saul was very wroth, and the saying displeased him; and he said, They have ascribed unto David ten thousands, and to me they have ascribed but thousands: and what can he have more but the kingdom?
verses.modern: Saul was very angry, and this saying displeased him. He said, "They have ascribed to David ten thousands, and to me they have ascribed thousands, and what more can he have but the kingdom?"

verses.kjv: And Saul eyed David from that day and forward.
verses.modern: Saul eyed David from that day on.

verses.kjv: And it came to pass on the morrow, that the evil spirit from God came upon Saul, and he prophesied in the midst of the house: and David played with his hand, as at other times: and there was a javelin in Saul's hand.
verses.modern: The next day an evil spirit from God rushed upon Saul. He raved within his house while David was playing the lyre, as he did day by day. Saul had his spear in his hand.

verses.kjv: And Saul cast the javelin; for he said, I will smite David even to the wall with it. And David avoided out of his presence twice.
verses.modern: Saul hurled the spear, for he thought, "I will pin David to the wall." But David evaded him twice.

verses.kjv: And Saul was afraid of David, because the LORD was with him, and was departed from Saul.
verses.modern: Saul was afraid of David, because the LORD was with Him but had departed from Saul.

verses.kjv: Therefore Saul removed him from him, and made him his captain over a thousand; and he went out and came in before the people.
verses.modern: So Saul removed him from his presence and made him a commander of a thousand. And he went out and came in before the people.

verses.kjv: And David behaved himself wisely in all his ways; and the LORD was with him.
verses.modern: David had success in all his undertakings, for the LORD was with Him.

verses.kjv: Wherefore when Saul saw that he behaved himself very wisely, he was afraid of him.
verses.modern: When Saul saw that he had great success, he stood in fearful awe of him.

verses.kjv: But all Israel and Judah loved David, because he went out and came in before them.
verses.modern: But all Israel and Judah loved David, for he went out and came in before them.

verses.kjv: And Saul said to David, Behold my elder daughter Merab, her will I give thee to wife: only be thou valiant for me, and fight the LORD'S battles. For Saul said, Let not mine hand be upon him, but let the hand of the Philistines be upon him.
verses.modern: Then Saul said to David, "Here is my elder daughter Merab. I will give her to you for a wife. Only be valiant for me and fight the LORD's battles." For Saul thought, "Let not my hand be against him, but let the hand of the Philistines be against Him."

verses.kjv: And David said unto Saul, Who am I? and what is my life, or my father's family in Israel, that I should be son in law to the king?
verses.modern: David said to Saul, "Who am I, and who are my relatives, my father's clan in Israel, that I should be son-in-law to the king?"

verses.kjv: But it came to pass at the time when Merab Saul's daughter should have been given to David, that she was given unto Adriel the Meholathite to wife.
verses.modern: But at the time when Merab, Saul's daughter, should have been given to David, she was given to Adriel the Meholathite for a wife.

verses.kjv: And Michal Saul's daughter loved David: and they told Saul, and the thing pleased him.
verses.modern: Now Michal, Saul's daughter, loved David. And they told Saul, and the thing pleased him.

verses.kjv: And Saul said, I will give him her, that she may be a snare to him, and that the hand of the Philistines may be against him. Wherefore Saul said to David, Thou shalt this day be my son in law in the one of the twain.
verses.modern: Saul thought, "Let me give her to him, that she may be a snare for him and that the hand of the Philistines may be against him." Therefore Saul said to David a second time, "You shall now be my son-in-law."

verses.kjv: And Saul commanded his servants, saying, Commune with David secretly, and say, Behold, the king hath delight in thee, and all his servants love thee: now therefore be the king's son in law.
verses.modern: Saul commanded his servants, "Speak to David privately and say, 'See, the king delights in you. All his servants love you. Now then become the king's son-in-law.' "

verses.kjv: And Saul's servants spake those words in the ears of David. And David said, Seemeth it to you a light thing to be a king's son in law, seeing that I am a poor man, and lightly esteemed?
verses.modern: Saul's servants spoke those words in the ears of David. And David said, "Does it seem to you a little thing to become the king's son-in-law, since I am a poor man and have no reputation?"

verses.kjv: And the servants of Saul told him, saying, On this manner spake David.
verses.modern: The servants of Saul told him, "Thus did David speak."

verses.kjv: And Saul said, Thus shall ye say to David, The king desireth not any dowry, but an hundred foreskins of the Philistines, to be avenged of the king's enemies. But Saul thought to make David fall by the hand of the Philistines.
verses.modern: Then Saul said, "Thus shall you say to David, 'The king desires no bride-price except a hundred foreskins of the Philistines, that he may be avenged of the king's enemies.' " Now Saul planned to make David fall by the hand of the Philistines.

verses.kjv: And when his servants told David these words, it pleased David well to be the king's son in law: and the days were not expired.
verses.modern: When his servants told David these words, it pleased David well to be the king's son-in-law. Before the time had expired,

verses.kjv: Wherefore David arose and went, he and his men, and slew of the Philistines two hundred men; and David brought their foreskins, and they gave them in full tale to the king, that he might be the king's son in law. And Saul gave him Michal his daughter to wife.
verses.modern: David arose and went, along with his men, and killed two hundred of the Philistines. And David brought their foreskins, which were given in full number to the king, that he might become the king's son-in-law. And Saul gave him his daughter Michal for a wife.

verses.kjv: And Saul saw and knew that the LORD was with David, and that Michal Saul's daughter loved him.
verses.modern: But when Saul saw and knew that the LORD was with David, and that Michal, Saul's daughter, loved him,

verses.kjv: And Saul was yet the more afraid of David; and Saul became David's enemy continually.
verses.modern: Saul was still more afraid of David. So Saul was David's enemy continually.

verses.kjv: Then the princes of the Philistines went forth: and it came to pass, after they went forth, that David behaved himself more wisely than all the servants of Saul; so that his name was much set by.
verses.modern: Then the commanders of the Philistines came out to battle, and as often as they came out David had more success than all the servants of Saul, so that his name was highly esteemed.

chapters.summary: Jonathan made a covenant of friendship with David, and David succeeded in everything Saul sent him to do. Saul became jealous when the women sang that David had slain his ten thousands, and he sought to kill David.

verses.kjv: And Saul spake to Jonathan his son, and to all his servants, that they should kill David.
verses.modern: Saul spoke to Jonathan his son and to all his servants, that they should kill David.

verses.kjv: But Jonathan Saul's son delighted much in David: and Jonathan told David, saying, Saul my father seeketh to kill thee: now therefore, I pray thee, take heed to thyself until the morning, and abide in a secret place, and hide thyself:
verses.modern: But Jonathan, Saul's son, delighted greatly in David. And Jonathan told David, "Saul my father seeks to kill you. Therefore be on your guard in the morning. Stay in a secret place and hide yourself.

verses.kjv: And I will go out and stand beside my father in the field where thou art, and I will commune with my father of thee; and what I see, that I will tell thee.
verses.modern: I will go out and stand beside my father in the field where you are. I will speak to my father about you. And if I learn anything I will tell you."

verses.kjv: And Jonathan spake good of David unto Saul his father, and said unto him, Let not the king sin against his servant, against David; because he hath not sinned against thee, and because his works have been to thee-ward very good:
verses.modern: Jonathan spoke well of David to Saul his father and said to him, "Let not the king sin against his servant David, because he has not sinned against you, and because his deeds have brought good to you.

verses.kjv: For he did put his life in his hand, and slew the Philistine, and the LORD wrought a great salvation for all Israel: thou sawest it, and didst rejoice: wherefore then wilt thou sin against innocent blood, to slay David without a cause?
verses.modern: For He took His life in His hand and He struck down the Philistine. The LORD worked a great salvation for all Israel. You saw it, and rejoiced. Why then will You sin against innocent blood by killing David without cause?"

verses.kjv: And Saul hearkened unto the voice of Jonathan: and Saul sware, As the LORD liveth, he shall not be slain.
verses.modern: Saul listened to the voice of Jonathan. Saul swore, "As the LORD lives, He shall not be put to death."

verses.kjv: And Jonathan called David, and Jonathan shewed him all those things. And Jonathan brought David to Saul, and he was in his presence, as in times past.
verses.modern: Jonathan called David, and Jonathan reported to him all these things. And Jonathan brought David to Saul. He was in his presence as before.

verses.kjv: And there was war again: and David went out, and fought with the Philistines, and slew them with a great slaughter; and they fled from him.
verses.modern: There was war again. And David went out and fought with the Philistines and struck them with a great blow, so that they fled before him.

verses.kjv: And the evil spirit from the LORD was upon Saul, as he sat in his house with his javelin in his hand: and David played with his hand.
verses.modern: Then an evil spirit from the LORD came upon Saul, as he sat in his house with his spear in his hand. And David was playing the lyre.

verses.kjv: And Saul sought to smite David even to the wall with the javelin; but he slipped away out of Saul's presence, and he smote the javelin into the wall: and David fled, and escaped that night.
verses.modern: Saul sought to pin David to the wall with the spear. But he eluded Saul, so that he struck the spear into the wall. And David fled and escaped that night.

verses.kjv: Saul also sent messengers unto David's house, to watch him, and to slay him in the morning: and Michal David's wife told him, saying, If thou save not thy life to night, to morrow thou shalt be slain.
verses.modern: Saul sent messengers to David's house to watch him, that he might kill him in the morning. But Michal, David's wife, told him, "If you do not escape with your life tonight, tomorrow you will be killed."

verses.kjv: So Michal let David down through a window: and he went, and fled, and escaped.
verses.modern: So Michal let David down through the window. He fled away and escaped.

verses.kjv: And Michal took an image, and laid it in the bed, and put a pillow of goats' hair for his bolster, and covered it with a cloth.
verses.modern: Michal took an idol and laid it on the bed and put a pillow of goats' hair at its head and covered it with the clothes.

verses.kjv: And when Saul sent messengers to take David, she said, He is sick.
verses.modern: When Saul sent messengers to take David, she said, "He is sick."

verses.kjv: And Saul sent the messengers again to see David, saying, Bring him up to me in the bed, that I may slay him.
verses.modern: Then Saul sent the messengers to see David, saying, "Bring him up to me in the bed, that I may kill him."

verses.kjv: And when the messengers were come in, behold, there was an image in the bed, with a pillow of goats' hair for his bolster.
verses.modern: When the messengers came in, there was the idol in the bed, with the pillow of goats' hair at its head.

verses.kjv: And Saul said unto Michal, Why hast thou deceived me so, and sent away mine enemy, that he is escaped? And Michal answered Saul, He said unto me, Let me go; why should I kill thee?
verses.modern: Saul said to Michal, "Why have you deceived me like this and let my enemy go, so that he has escaped?" And Michal answered Saul, "He said to me, 'Let me go. Why should I kill you?'"

verses.kjv: So David fled, and escaped, and came to Samuel to Ramah, and told him all that Saul had done to him. And he and Samuel went and dwelt in Naioth.
verses.modern: Now David fled and escaped. He came to Samuel at Ramah and told him all that Saul had done to him. And he and Samuel went and lived at Naioth.

verses.kjv: And it was told Saul, saying, Behold, David is at Naioth in Ramah.
verses.modern: It was told Saul, "See, David is at Naioth in Ramah."

verses.kjv: And Saul sent messengers to take David: and when they saw the company of the prophets prophesying, and Samuel standing as appointed over them, the Spirit of God was upon the messengers of Saul, and they also prophesied.
verses.modern: Then Saul sent messengers to take David, and when they saw the company of the prophets prophesying, and Samuel standing as head over them, the Spirit of God came upon the messengers of Saul. They also prophesied.

verses.kjv: And when it was told Saul, he sent other messengers, and they prophesied likewise. And Saul sent messengers again the third time, and they prophesied also.
verses.modern: When it was told Saul, he sent other messengers. They also prophesied. And Saul sent messengers again the third time. They also prophesied.

verses.kjv: Then went he also to Ramah, and came to a great well that is in Sechu: and he asked and said, Where are Samuel and David? And one said, Behold, they be at Naioth in Ramah.
verses.modern: Then he himself went to Ramah and came to the great well that is in Secu. And he asked, "Where are Samuel and David?" And one said, "See, they are at Naioth in Ramah."

verses.kjv: And he went thither to Naioth in Ramah: and the Spirit of God was upon him also, and he went on, and prophesied, until he came to Naioth in Ramah.
verses.modern: He went there to Naioth in Ramah. And the Spirit of God came upon Him also, and as He went He prophesied until He came to Naioth in Ramah.

verses.kjv: And he stripped off his clothes also, and prophesied before Samuel in like manner, and lay down naked all that day and all that night. Wherefore they say, Is Saul also among the prophets?
verses.modern: He too stripped off his robes. He too prophesied before Samuel and lay naked all that day and all that night. Thus it is said, "Is Saul also among the prophets?"

chapters.summary: Saul ordered Jonathan and his servants to kill David, but Jonathan interceded for him. Saul tried twice to pin David to the wall with a spear, and Michal helped David escape through a window; David fled to Samuel at Ramah.

verses.kjv: And David fled from Naioth in Ramah, and came and said before Jonathan, What have I done? what is mine iniquity? and what is my sin before thy father, that he seeketh my life?
verses.modern: Then David fled from Naioth in Ramah and came and said before Jonathan, "What have I done? What is my guilt? And what is my sin before your father, that he seeks my life?"

verses.kjv: And he said unto him, God forbid; thou shalt not die: behold, my father will do nothing either great or small, but that he will shew it me: and why should my father hide this thing from me? it is not so.
verses.modern: He said to him, "Far from it! You shall not die. See, my father does nothing either great or small without disclosing it to me. And why should my father hide this from me? It is not so."

verses.kjv: And David sware moreover, and said, Thy father certainly knoweth that I have found grace in thine eyes; and he saith, Let not Jonathan know this, lest he be grieved: but truly as the LORD liveth, and as thy soul liveth, there is but a step between me and death.
verses.modern: But David vowed again, saying, "Your father knows well that I have found favor in Your eyes. He thinks, 'Do not let Jonathan know this, lest he be grieved.' But truly, as the LORD lives and as Your soul lives, there is but a step between me and death."

verses.kjv: Then said Jonathan unto David, Whatsoever thy soul desireth, I will even do it for thee.
verses.modern: Then Jonathan said to David, "Whatever you say, I will do for you."

verses.kjv: And David said unto Jonathan, Behold, to morrow is the new moon, and I should not fail to sit with the king at meat: but let me go, that I may hide myself in the field unto the third day at even.
verses.modern: David said to Jonathan, "See, tomorrow is the new moon. I should not fail to sit at table with the king. But let me go, that I may hide myself in the field till the third day at evening.

verses.kjv: If thy father at all miss me, then say, David earnestly asked leave of me that he might run to Bethlehem his city: for there is a yearly sacrifice there for all the family.
verses.modern: If your father misses me at all, then say, 'David earnestly asked leave of me to run to Bethlehem his city, for there is a yearly sacrifice there for all the clan.'

verses.kjv: If he say thus, It is well; thy servant shall have peace: but if he be very wroth, then be sure that evil is determined by him.
verses.modern: If he says, 'Good!' it will be well with your servant, but if he is angry, then know that harm is determined by him.

verses.kjv: Therefore thou shalt deal kindly with thy servant; for thou hast brought thy servant into a covenant of the LORD with thee: notwithstanding, if there be in me iniquity, slay thou me; for why shouldest thou bring me to thy father?
verses.modern: Therefore deal kindly with Your servant, for You have brought Your servant into a covenant of the LORD with You. But if there is guilt in me, kill me Yourself, for why should You bring me to Your father?"

verses.kjv: And Jonathan said, Far be it from thee: for if I knew certainly that evil were determined by my father to come upon thee, then would not I tell it thee?
verses.modern: Jonathan said, "Far be it from you! If I knew that it was determined by my father that harm should come to you, would I not tell you?"

verses.kjv: Then said David to Jonathan, Who shall tell me? or what if thy father answer thee roughly?
verses.modern: Then David said to Jonathan, "Who will tell me if your father answers you harshly?"

verses.kjv: And Jonathan said unto David, Come, and let us go out into the field. And they went out both of them into the field.
verses.modern: Jonathan said to David, "Come, let us go out into the field." So they both went out into the field.

verses.kjv: And Jonathan said unto David, O LORD God of Israel, when I have sounded my father about to morrow any time, or the third day, and, behold, if there be good toward David, and I then send not unto thee, and shew it thee;
verses.modern: Jonathan said to David, "The LORD, the God of Israel, be witness! When I have sounded out my father, about this time tomorrow, or the third day, if He is well disposed toward David, shall I not then send and disclose it to you?

verses.kjv: The LORD do so and much more to Jonathan: but if it please my father to do thee evil, then I will shew it thee, and send thee away, that thou mayest go in peace: and the LORD be with thee, as he hath been with my father.
verses.modern: But should it please my father to do You harm, the LORD do so to Jonathan and more also if I do not disclose it to you and send You away, that You may go in safety. May the LORD be with You, as He has been with my father.

verses.kjv: And thou shalt not only while yet I live shew me the kindness of the LORD, that I die not:
verses.modern: If I am still alive, show me the mercy of the LORD, that I may not die;

verses.kjv: But also thou shalt not cut off thy kindness from my house for ever: no, not when the LORD hath cut off the enemies of David every one from the face of the earth.
verses.modern: Do not cut off Your mercy from my house forever, when the LORD cuts off every one of the enemies of David from the face of the earth."

verses.kjv: So Jonathan made a covenant with the house of David, saying, Let the LORD even require it at the hand of David's enemies.
verses.modern: Jonathan made a covenant with the house of David, saying, "May the LORD take vengeance on David's enemies."

verses.kjv: And Jonathan caused David to swear again, because he loved him: for he loved him as he loved his own soul.
verses.modern: Jonathan made David swear again by his love for him, for he loved him as he loved his own soul.

verses.kjv: Then Jonathan said to David, To morrow is the new moon: and thou shalt be missed, because thy seat will be empty.
verses.modern: Then Jonathan said to him, "Tomorrow is the new moon, and you will be missed, because your seat will be empty.

verses.kjv: And when thou hast stayed three days, then thou shalt go down quickly, and come to the place where thou didst hide thyself when the business was in hand, and shalt remain by the stone Ezel.
verses.modern: On the third day go down quickly to the place where you hid yourself on that day of trouble, and remain beside the stone Ezel.

verses.kjv: And I will shoot three arrows on the side thereof, as though I shot at a mark.
verses.modern: I will shoot three arrows to the side of it, as though I were shooting at a mark.

verses.kjv: And, behold, I will send a lad, saying, Go, find out the arrows. If I expressly say unto the lad, Behold, the arrows are on this side of thee, take them; then come thou: for there is peace to thee, and no hurt; as the LORD liveth.
verses.modern: I will send the boy and say, 'Go, find the arrows.' If I say to the boy, 'Look, the arrows are on this side of you, take them,' then You are to come, for, as the LORD lives, it is safe for You and there is no danger.

verses.kjv: But if I say thus unto the young man, Behold, the arrows are beyond thee; go thy way: for the LORD hath sent thee away.
verses.modern: But if I say to the boy, 'Look, the arrows are beyond you,' then go, for the LORD has sent You away.

verses.kjv: And as touching the matter which thou and I have spoken of, behold, the LORD be between thee and me for ever.
verses.modern: As for the matter of which You and I have spoken, the LORD is between You and me forever."

verses.kjv: So David hid himself in the field: and when the new moon was come, the king sat him down to eat meat.
verses.modern: So David hid himself in the field. And when the new moon came, the king sat down to eat food.

verses.kjv: And the king sat upon his seat, as at other times, even upon a seat by the wall: and Jonathan arose, and Abner sat by Saul's side, and David's place was empty.
verses.modern: The king sat on his seat, as at other times, on the seat by the wall. Jonathan sat opposite, and Abner sat by Saul's side, but David's place was empty.

verses.kjv: Nevertheless Saul spake not any thing that day: for he thought, Something hath befallen him, he is not clean; surely he is not clean.
verses.modern: Yet Saul did not say anything that day, for he thought, "Something has happened to him. He is not clean; surely he is not clean."

verses.kjv: And it came to pass on the morrow, which was the second day of the month, that David's place was empty: and Saul said unto Jonathan his son, Wherefore cometh not the son of Jesse to meat, neither yesterday, nor to day?
verses.modern: But on the second day, the day after the new moon, David's place was empty. And Saul said to Jonathan his son, "Why has the son of Jesse not come to the meal, either yesterday or today?"

verses.kjv: And Jonathan answered Saul, David earnestly asked leave of me to go to Bethlehem:
verses.modern: Jonathan answered Saul, "David earnestly asked leave of me to go to Bethlehem.

verses.kjv: And he said, Let me go, I pray thee; for our family hath a sacrifice in the city; and my brother, he hath commanded me to be there: and now, if I have found favour in thine eyes, let me get away, I pray thee, and see my brethren. Therefore he cometh not unto the king's table.
verses.modern: He said, 'Let me go, for our clan holds a sacrifice in the city, and my brother has commanded me to be there. So now, if I have found favor in your eyes, let me get away and see my brothers.' For this reason he has not come to the king's table."

verses.kjv: Then Saul's anger was kindled against Jonathan, and he said unto him, Thou son of the perverse rebellious woman, do not I know that thou hast chosen the son of Jesse to thine own confusion, and unto the confusion of thy mother's nakedness?
verses.modern: Then Saul's anger was kindled against Jonathan. He said to him, "You son of a perverse, rebellious woman! Do I not know that you have chosen the son of Jesse to your own shame, and to the shame of your mother's nakedness?

verses.kjv: For as long as the son of Jesse liveth upon the ground, thou shalt not be established, nor thy kingdom. Wherefore now send and fetch him unto me, for he shall surely die.
verses.modern: For as long as the son of Jesse lives on the earth, neither you nor your kingdom shall be established. Therefore send and bring him to me, for he shall surely die."

verses.kjv: And Jonathan answered Saul his father, and said unto him, Wherefore shall he be slain? what hath he done?
verses.modern: Then Jonathan answered Saul his father, "Why should he be put to death? What has he done?"

verses.kjv: And Saul cast a javelin at him to smite him: whereby Jonathan knew that it was determined of his father to slay David.
verses.modern: But Saul hurled his spear at him to strike him. So Jonathan knew that his father was determined to put David to death.

verses.kjv: So Jonathan arose from the table in fierce anger, and did eat no meat the second day of the month: for he was grieved for David, because his father had done him shame.
verses.modern: Jonathan rose from the table in fierce anger and ate no food the second day of the month, for he was grieved for David, because his father had disgraced him.

verses.kjv: And it came to pass in the morning, that Jonathan went out into the field at the time appointed with David, and a little lad with him.
verses.modern: In the morning Jonathan went out into the field to the appointment with David, and with him a little boy.

verses.kjv: And he said unto his lad, Run, find out now the arrows which I shoot. And as the lad ran, he shot an arrow beyond him.
verses.modern: He said to his boy, "Run and find the arrows that I shoot." As the boy ran, he shot an arrow beyond him.

verses.kjv: And when the lad was come to the place of the arrow which Jonathan had shot, Jonathan cried after the lad, and said, Is not the arrow beyond thee?
verses.modern: When the boy came to the place of the arrow that Jonathan had shot, Jonathan called after the boy and said, "Is not the arrow beyond you?"

verses.kjv: And Jonathan cried after the lad, Make speed, haste, stay not. And Jonathan's lad gathered up the arrows, and came to his master.
verses.modern: Jonathan called after the boy, "Hurry! Be quick! Do not stop!" So Jonathan's boy gathered up the arrows and came to his master.

verses.kjv: But the lad knew not any thing: only Jonathan and David knew the matter.
verses.modern: But the boy knew nothing. Only Jonathan and David knew the matter.

verses.kjv: And Jonathan gave his artillery unto his lad, and said unto him, Go, carry them to the city.
verses.modern: Jonathan gave his weapons to his boy and said to him, "Go and carry them to the city."

verses.kjv: And as soon as the lad was gone, David arose out of a place toward the south, and fell on his face to the ground, and bowed himself three times: and they kissed one another, and wept one with another, until David exceeded.
verses.modern: As soon as the boy had gone, David rose from a place toward the south and fell on his face to the ground and bowed three times. And they kissed one another and wept with one another, David weeping the most.

verses.kjv: And Jonathan said to David, Go in peace, forasmuch as we have sworn both of us in the name of the LORD, saying, The LORD be between me and thee, and between my seed and thy seed for ever. And he arose and departed: and Jonathan went into the city.
verses.modern: Then Jonathan said to David, "Go in peace, because we have sworn both of us in the name of the LORD, saying, 'The LORD shall be between me and You, and between my seed and Your seed, forever.' " And He rose and departed, and Jonathan went into the city.

chapters.summary: David and Jonathan devised a plan to test Saul's intentions at the new moon feast. When Saul's murderous rage was confirmed, Jonathan warned David with the prearranged arrow signal, and the two friends parted in tears.

verses.kjv: Then came David to Nob to Ahimelech the priest: and Ahimelech was afraid at the meeting of David, and said unto him, Why art thou alone, and no man with thee?
verses.modern: Then David came to Nob, to Ahimelech the priest. And Ahimelech came to meet David trembling and said to him, "Why are you alone, and no one with you?"

verses.kjv: And David said unto Ahimelech the priest, The king hath commanded me a business, and hath said unto me, Let no man know any thing of the business whereabout I send thee, and what I have commanded thee: and I have appointed my servants to such and such a place.
verses.modern: David said to Ahimelech the priest, "The king has charged me with a matter and said to me, 'Let no one know anything of the matter about which I send you, and with which I have charged you.' I have made an appointment with the young men for such and such a place.

verses.kjv: Now therefore what is under thine hand? give me five loaves of bread in mine hand, or what there is present.
verses.modern: Now then, what do you have on hand? Give me five loaves of bread, or whatever is here."

verses.kjv: And the priest answered David, and said, There is no common bread under mine hand, but there is hallowed bread; if the young men have kept themselves at least from women.
verses.modern: The priest answered David, "I have no common bread on hand, but there is holy bread—if the young men have kept themselves from women."

verses.kjv: And David answered the priest, and said unto him, Of a truth women have been kept from us about these three days, since I came out, and the vessels of the young men are holy, and the bread is in a manner common, yea, though it were sanctified this day in the vessel.
verses.modern: David answered the priest, "Truly women have been kept from us as always when I go on an expedition. The vessels of the young men are holy even when it is an ordinary journey. How much more today will their vessels be holy?"

verses.kjv: So the priest gave him hallowed bread: for there was no bread there but the shewbread, that was taken from before the LORD, to put hot bread in the day when it was taken away.
verses.modern: So the priest gave him the holy bread, for there was no bread there but the bread of the Presence, which is removed from before the LORD, to be replaced by hot bread on the day it is taken away.

verses.kjv: Now a certain man of the servants of Saul was there that day, detained before the LORD; and his name was Doeg, an Edomite, the chiefest of the herdmen that belonged to Saul.
verses.modern: Now a certain man of the servants of Saul was there that day, detained before the LORD. His name was Doeg the Edomite, the chief of Saul's herdsmen.

verses.kjv: And David said unto Ahimelech, And is there not here under thine hand spear or sword? for I have neither brought my sword nor my weapons with me, because the king's business required haste.
verses.modern: David said to Ahimelech, "Then do you not have a spear or a sword at hand? For I have brought neither my sword nor my weapons with me, because the king's business required haste."

verses.kjv: And the priest said, The sword of Goliath the Philistine, whom thou slewest in the valley of Elah, behold, it is here wrapped in a cloth behind the ephod: if thou wilt take that, take it: for there is no other save that here. And David said, There is none like that; give it me.
verses.modern: The priest said, "The sword of Goliath the Philistine, whom you struck down in the Valley of Elah, there it is, wrapped in a cloth behind the ephod. If you will take that, take it, for there is none but that here." And David said, "There is none like that; give it to me."

verses.kjv: And David arose, and fled that day for fear of Saul, and went to Achish the king of Gath.
verses.modern: David rose and fled that day from Saul and went to Achish the king of Gath.

verses.kjv: And the servants of Achish said unto him, Is not this David the king of the land? did they not sing one to another of him in dances, saying, Saul hath slain his thousands, and David his ten thousands?
verses.modern: The servants of Achish said to him, "Is not this David the king of the land? Did they not sing to one another of him in dances, 'Saul has struck down his thousands, and David his ten thousands'?"

verses.kjv: And David laid up these words in his heart, and was sore afraid of Achish the king of Gath.
verses.modern: David took these words to heart and was very much afraid of Achish the king of Gath.

verses.kjv: And he changed his behaviour before them, and feigned himself mad in their hands, and scrabbled on the doors of the gate, and let his spittle fall down upon his beard.
verses.modern: So he changed his behavior before them and pretended to be insane in their hands and made marks on the doors of the gate and let his spittle run down his beard.

verses.kjv: Then said Achish unto his servants, Lo, ye see the man is mad: wherefore then have ye brought him to me?
verses.modern: Then Achish said to his servants, "See, the man is mad. Why then have you brought him to me?

verses.kjv: Have I need of mad men, that ye have brought this fellow to play the mad man in my presence? shall this fellow come into my house?
verses.modern: Do I lack madmen, that you have brought this fellow to behave as a madman in my presence? Shall this fellow come into my house?"

chapters.summary: David fled to Nob and received the showbread and the sword of Goliath from Ahimelech the priest. He then went to Achish king of Gath but feared for his life and pretended to be insane.

verses.kjv: David therefore departed thence, and escaped to the cave Adullam: and when his brethren and all his father's house heard it, they went down thither to him.
verses.modern: David departed from there and escaped to the cave of Adullam. And when his brothers and all his father's house heard it, they went down there to him.

verses.kjv: And every one that was in distress, and every one that was in debt, and every one that was discontented, gathered themselves unto him; and he became a captain over them: and there were with him about four hundred men.
verses.modern: Everyone who was in distress, and everyone who was in debt, and everyone who was bitter in soul, gathered to him. And he became commander over them. And there were with him about four hundred men.

verses.kjv: And David went thence to Mizpeh of Moab: and he said unto the king of Moab, Let my father and my mother, I pray thee, come forth, and be with you, till I know what God will do for me.
verses.modern: David went from there to Mizpeh of Moab. And he said to the king of Moab, "Please let my father and my mother stay with you, until I know what God will do for me."

verses.kjv: And he brought them before the king of Moab: and they dwelt with him all the while that David was in the hold.
verses.modern: He left them with the king of Moab. They stayed with him all the time that David was in the stronghold.

verses.kjv: And the prophet Gad said unto David, Abide not in the hold; depart, and get thee into the land of Judah. Then David departed, and came into the forest of Hareth.
verses.modern: Then the prophet Gad said to David, "Do not remain in the stronghold; depart, and go into the land of Judah." So David departed and went into the forest of Hereth.

verses.kjv: When Saul heard that David was discovered, and the men that were with him, (now Saul abode in Gibeah under a tree in Ramah, having his spear in his hand, and all his servants were standing about him;)
verses.modern: Now Saul heard that David was discovered, and the men who were with him. Saul was sitting at Gibeah, under the tamarisk tree on the height, with his spear in his hand. All his servants were standing about him.

verses.kjv: Then Saul said unto his servants that stood about him, Hear now, ye Benjamites; will the son of Jesse give every one of you fields and vineyards, and make you all captains of thousands, and captains of hundreds;
verses.modern: Saul said to his servants who stood about him, "Hear now, people of Benjamin; will the son of Jesse give every one of you fields and vineyards, will he make you all commanders of thousands and commanders of hundreds,

verses.kjv: That all of you have conspired against me, and there is none that sheweth me that my son hath made a league with the son of Jesse, and there is none of you that is sorry for me, or sheweth unto me that my son hath stirred up my servant against me, to lie in wait, as at this day?
verses.modern: That all of you have conspired against me? No one discloses to me when my son makes a covenant with the son of Jesse. None of you is sorry for me or discloses to me that my son has stirred up my servant against me, to lie in ambush, as at this day."

verses.kjv: Then answered Doeg the Edomite, which was set over the servants of Saul, and said, I saw the son of Jesse coming to Nob, to Ahimelech the son of Ahitub.
verses.modern: Then answered Doeg the Edomite, who stood by the servants of Saul, "I saw the son of Jesse coming to Nob, to Ahimelech the son of Ahitub,

verses.kjv: And he enquired of the LORD for him, and gave him victuals, and gave him the sword of Goliath the Philistine.
verses.modern: He inquired of the LORD for Him and gave Him provisions and gave Him the sword of Goliath the Philistine."

verses.kjv: Then the king sent to call Ahimelech the priest, the son of Ahitub, and all his father's house, the priests that were in Nob: and they came all of them to the king.
verses.modern: Then the king sent to summon Ahimelech the priest, the son of Ahitub. All his father's house, the priests who were at Nob. All of them came to the king.

verses.kjv: And Saul said, Hear now, thou son of Ahitub. And he answered, Here I am, my lord.
verses.modern: Saul said, "Hear now, son of Ahitub." And he answered, "Here I am, my lord."

verses.kjv: And Saul said unto him, Why have ye conspired against me, thou and the son of Jesse, in that thou hast given him bread, and a sword, and hast enquired of God for him, that he should rise against me, to lie in wait, as at this day?
verses.modern: Saul said to him, "Why have you conspired against me, you and the son of Jesse, in that you have given him bread and a sword and have inquired of God for Him, so that He has risen against me, to lie in ambush, as at this day?"

verses.kjv: Then Ahimelech answered the king, and said, And who is so faithful among all thy servants as David, which is the king's son in law, and goeth at thy bidding, and is honourable in thine house?
verses.modern: Then Ahimelech answered the king, "And who among all your servants is so faithful as David, who is the king's son-in-law, and goes at your bidding, and is honored in your house?

verses.kjv: Did I then begin to enquire of God for him? be it far from me: let not the king impute any thing unto his servant, nor to all the house of my father: for thy servant knew nothing of all this, less or more.
verses.modern: Is today the first time that I have inquired of God for Him? Far be it from me! Let not the king impute anything to his servant or to all the house of my father, for your servant has known nothing of all this, much or little."

verses.kjv: And the king said, Thou shalt surely die, Ahimelech, thou, and all thy father's house.
verses.modern: The king said, "You shall surely die, Ahimelech, you and all your father's house."

verses.kjv: And the king said unto the footmen that stood about him, Turn, and slay the priests of the LORD; because their hand also is with David, and because they knew when he fled, and did not shew it to me. But the servants of the king would not put forth their hand to fall upon the priests of the LORD.
verses.modern: The king said to the guard who stood about him, "Turn and kill the priests of the LORD, because their hand also is with David. They knew that he fled and did not disclose it to me." But the servants of the king would not put out their hand to strike the priests of the LORD.

verses.kjv: And the king said to Doeg, Turn thou, and fall upon the priests. And Doeg the Edomite turned, and he fell upon the priests, and slew on that day fourscore and five persons that did wear a linen ephod.
verses.modern: Then the king said to Doeg, "You turn and strike the priests." And Doeg the Edomite turned and struck the priests. He killed on that day eighty-five men who wore the linen ephod.

verses.kjv: And Nob, the city of the priests, smote he with the edge of the sword, both men and women, children and sucklings, and oxen, and asses, and sheep, with the edge of the sword.
verses.modern: Nob, the city of the priests, he struck with the edge of the sword, both man and woman, child and infant, ox, donkey and sheep, with the edge of the sword.

verses.kjv: And one of the sons of Ahimelech the son of Ahitub, named Abiathar, escaped, and fled after David.
verses.modern: But one of the sons of Ahimelech the son of Ahitub, named Abiathar, escaped and fled after David.

verses.kjv: And Abiathar shewed David that Saul had slain the LORD'S priests.
verses.modern: Abiathar told David that Saul had killed the priests of the LORD.

verses.kjv: And David said unto Abiathar, I knew it that day, when Doeg the Edomite was there, that he would surely tell Saul: I have occasioned the death of all the persons of thy father's house.
verses.modern: David said to Abiathar, "I knew on that day, when Doeg the Edomite was there, that he would surely tell Saul. I have caused the death of all the persons of your father's house.

verses.kjv: Abide thou with me, fear not: for he that seeketh my life seeketh thy life: but with me thou shalt be in safeguard.
verses.modern: Stay with me; do not be afraid, for he who seeks my life seeks your life. With me you shall be safe."

chapters.summary: David gathered a band of outcasts at the cave of Adullam. Saul accused his servants of conspiracy and ordered Doeg the Edomite to kill the priests of Nob; eighty-five priests were slaughtered, and only Abiathar escaped to David.

verses.kjv: Then they told David, saying, Behold, the Philistines fight against Keilah, and they rob the threshingfloors.
verses.modern: Now they told David, "See, the Philistines are fighting against Keilah and are robbing the threshing floors."

verses.kjv: Therefore David enquired of the LORD, saying, Shall I go and smite these Philistines? And the LORD said unto David, Go, and smite the Philistines, and save Keilah.
verses.modern: Therefore David inquired of the LORD, "Shall I go and attack these Philistines?" And the LORD said to David, "Go and attack the Philistines and save Keilah."

verses.kjv: And David's men said unto him, Behold, we be afraid here in Judah: how much more then if we come to Keilah against the armies of the Philistines?
verses.modern: But David's men said to him, "See, we are afraid here in Judah. How much more then if we go to Keilah against the armies of the Philistines?"

verses.kjv: Then David enquired of the LORD yet again. And the LORD answered him and said, Arise, go down to Keilah; for I will deliver the Philistines into thine hand.
verses.modern: Then David inquired of the LORD again. And the LORD answered Him, "Arise, go down to Keilah, for I will give the Philistines into Your hand."

verses.kjv: So David and his men went to Keilah, and fought with the Philistines, and brought away their cattle, and smote them with a great slaughter. So David saved the inhabitants of Keilah.
verses.modern: David and his men went to Keilah and fought with the Philistines and brought away their livestock and struck them with a great blow. So David saved the inhabitants of Keilah.

verses.kjv: And it came to pass, when Abiathar the son of Ahimelech fled to David to Keilah, that he came down with an ephod in his hand.
verses.modern: When Abiathar the son of Ahimelech had fled to David to Keilah, he had come down with an ephod in his hand.

verses.kjv: And it was told Saul that David was come to Keilah. And Saul said, God hath delivered him into mine hand; for he is shut in, by entering into a town that hath gates and bars.
verses.modern: Now it was told Saul that David had come to Keilah. And Saul said, "God has given Him into my hand, for He has shut himself in by entering a town that has gates and bars."

verses.kjv: And Saul called all the people together to war, to go down to Keilah, to besiege David and his men.
verses.modern: Saul summoned all the people to war, to go down to Keilah, to besiege David and his men.

verses.kjv: And David knew that Saul secretly practised mischief against him; and he said to Abiathar the priest, Bring hither the ephod.
verses.modern: David knew that Saul was plotting harm against him. And he said to Abiathar the priest, "Bring the ephod here."

verses.kjv: Then said David, O LORD God of Israel, thy servant hath certainly heard that Saul seeketh to come to Keilah, to destroy the city for my sake.
verses.modern: Then David said, "O LORD, the God of Israel, Your servant has surely heard that Saul seeks to come to Keilah, to destroy the city on my account.

verses.kjv: Will the men of Keilah deliver me up into his hand? will Saul come down, as thy servant hath heard? O LORD God of Israel, I beseech thee, tell thy servant. And the LORD said, He will come down.
verses.modern: Will the men of Keilah surrender me into His hand? Will Saul come down, as your servant has heard? O LORD, the God of Israel, please tell Your servant." And the LORD said, "He will come down."

verses.kjv: Then said David, Will the men of Keilah deliver me and my men into the hand of Saul? And the LORD said, They will deliver thee up.
verses.modern: Then David said, "Will the men of Keilah surrender me and my men into the hand of Saul?" And the LORD said, "They will surrender You."

verses.kjv: Then David and his men, which were about six hundred, arose and departed out of Keilah, and went whithersoever they could go. And it was told Saul that David was escaped from Keilah; and he forbare to go forth.
verses.modern: Then David and his men, who were about six hundred, arose and departed from Keilah. They went wherever they could go. When Saul was told that David had escaped from Keilah, he gave up the expedition.

verses.kjv: And David abode in the wilderness in strong holds, and remained in a mountain in the wilderness of Ziph. And Saul sought him every day, but God delivered him not into his hand.
verses.modern: David remained in the strongholds in the wilderness, in the hill country in the wilderness of Ziph. And Saul sought him every day. But God did not give Him into His hand.

verses.kjv: And David saw that Saul was come out to seek his life: and David was in the wilderness of Ziph in a wood.
verses.modern: David saw that Saul had come out to seek his life. David was in the wilderness of Ziph in a wood.

verses.kjv: And Jonathan Saul's son arose, and went to David into the wood, and strengthened his hand in God.
verses.modern: Jonathan, Saul's son, rose and went to David into the wood, and strengthened his hand in God.

verses.kjv: And he said unto him, Fear not: for the hand of Saul my father shall not find thee; and thou shalt be king over Israel, and I shall be next unto thee; and that also Saul my father knoweth.
verses.modern: He said to him, "Do not be afraid, for the hand of Saul my father shall not find you. You shall be king over Israel. I shall be next to you. Saul my father also knows this."

verses.kjv: And they two made a covenant before the LORD: and David abode in the wood, and Jonathan went to his house.
verses.modern: The two of them made a covenant before the LORD. David remained in the wood, and Jonathan went home.

verses.kjv: Then came up the Ziphites to Saul to Gibeah, saying, Doth not David hide himself with us in strong holds in the wood, in the hill of Hachilah, which is on the south of Jeshimon?
verses.modern: Then the Ziphites went up to Saul at Gibeah, saying, "Is not David hiding among us in the strongholds in the wood, on the hill of Hachilah, which is south of Jeshimon?

verses.kjv: Now therefore, O king, come down according to all the desire of thy soul to come down; and our part shall be to deliver him into the king's hand.
verses.modern: Now come down, O king, according to all your heart's desire to come down, and our part shall be to surrender him into the king's hand."

verses.kjv: And Saul said, Blessed be ye of the LORD; for ye have compassion on me.
verses.modern: Saul said, "May you be blessed by the LORD, for You have had compassion on me.

verses.kjv: Go, I pray you, prepare yet, and know and see his place where his haunt is, and who hath seen him there: for it is told me that he dealeth very subtilly.
verses.modern: Go, make yet more sure. Know and see the place where His foot is, and who has seen Him there, for it is told me that He is very cunning.

verses.kjv: See therefore, and take knowledge of all the lurking places where he hideth himself, and come ye again to me with the certainty, and I will go with you: and it shall come to pass, if he be in the land, that I will search him out throughout all the thousands of Judah.
verses.modern: See therefore, and learn all the hiding places where He hides, and come back to me with sure information. Then I will go with You. And if He is in the land, I will search Him out among all the thousands of Judah."

verses.kjv: And they arose, and went to Ziph before Saul: but David and his men were in the wilderness of Maon, in the plain on the south of Jeshimon.
verses.modern: They arose and went to Ziph ahead of Saul. But David and his men were in the wilderness of Maon, in the plain to the south of Jeshimon.

verses.kjv: Saul also and his men went to seek him. And they told David: wherefore he came down into a rock, and abode in the wilderness of Maon. And when Saul heard that, he pursued after David in the wilderness of Maon.
verses.modern: Saul and his men went to seek him. And David was told, so he went down to the rock and lived in the wilderness of Maon. And when Saul heard that, he pursued David in the wilderness of Maon.

verses.kjv: And Saul went on this side of the mountain, and David and his men on that side of the mountain: and David made haste to get away for fear of Saul; for Saul and his men compassed David and his men round about to take them.
verses.modern: Saul went on one side of the mountain, and David and his men on the other side of the mountain. And David was hurrying to get away from Saul. As Saul and his men were closing in on David and his men to capture them,

verses.kjv: But there came a messenger unto Saul, saying, Haste thee, and come; for the Philistines have invaded the land.
verses.modern: A messenger came to Saul, saying, "Hurry and come, for the Philistines have raided the land."

verses.kjv: Wherefore Saul returned from pursuing after David, and went against the Philistines: therefore they called that place Selahammahlekoth.
verses.modern: So Saul turned back from pursuing David and went against the Philistines. Therefore that place was called Selahammahlekoth.

verses.kjv: And David went up from thence, and dwelt in strong holds at Engedi.
verses.modern: David went up from there and lived in the strongholds of En-gedi.

chapters.summary: David rescued the city of Keilah from the Philistines, but fled when God warned that the men of Keilah would surrender him to Saul. Saul pursued David in the wilderness of Ziph, but Jonathan came and strengthened David's hand in God.

verses.kjv: And it came to pass, when Saul was returned from following the Philistines, that it was told him, saying, Behold, David is in the wilderness of Engedi.
verses.modern: When Saul returned from following the Philistines, he was told, "See, David is in the wilderness of En-gedi."

verses.kjv: Then Saul took three thousand chosen men out of all Israel, and went to seek David and his men upon the rocks of the wild goats.
verses.modern: Then Saul took three thousand chosen men out of all Israel and went to seek David and his men in front of the Rocks of the Wild Goats.

verses.kjv: And he came to the sheepcotes by the way, where was a cave; and Saul went in to cover his feet: and David and his men remained in the sides of the cave.
verses.modern: He came to the sheepfolds beside the road, where there was a cave, and Saul went in to relieve himself. Now David and his men were sitting in the innermost parts of the cave.

verses.kjv: And the men of David said unto him, Behold the day of which the LORD said unto thee, Behold, I will deliver thine enemy into thine hand, that thou mayest do to him as it shall seem good unto thee. Then David arose, and cut off the skirt of Saul's robe privily.
verses.modern: The men of David said to him, "Here is the day of which the LORD said to You, 'I will give Your enemy into Your hand, and You shall do to Him as it seems good to You.' " Then David arose and stealthily cut off a corner of Saul's robe.

verses.kjv: And it came to pass afterward, that David's heart smote him, because he had cut off Saul's skirt.
verses.modern: Afterward David's heart struck him, because he had cut off a corner of Saul's robe.

verses.kjv: And he said unto his men, The LORD forbid that I should do this thing unto my master, the LORD'S anointed, to stretch forth mine hand against him, seeing he is the anointed of the LORD.
verses.modern: He said to His men, "The LORD forbid that I should do this thing to my lord, the LORD's anointed, to put out my hand against Him, seeing He is the LORD's anointed."

verses.kjv: So David stayed his servants with these words, and suffered them not to rise against Saul. But Saul rose up out of the cave, and went on his way.
verses.modern: So David persuaded his men with these words and did not permit them to attack Saul. And Saul rose up and left the cave and went on his way.

verses.kjv: David also arose afterward, and went out of the cave, and cried after Saul, saying, My lord the king. And when Saul looked behind him, David stooped with his face to the earth, and bowed himself.
verses.modern: Afterward David also arose and went out of the cave, and called after Saul, "My lord the king!" And when Saul looked behind him, David bowed with his face to the earth and paid homage.

verses.kjv: And David said to Saul, Wherefore hearest thou men's words, saying, Behold, David seeketh thy hurt?
verses.modern: David said to Saul, "Why do you listen to the words of men who say, 'See, David seeks your harm'?

verses.kjv: Behold, this day thine eyes have seen how that the LORD had delivered thee to day into mine hand in the cave: and some bade me kill thee: but mine eye spared thee; and I said, I will not put forth mine hand against my lord; for he is the LORD'S anointed.
verses.modern: See, this day Your eyes have seen how the LORD gave You today into my hand in the cave. And some told me to kill You. But I spared You. I said, 'I will not put out my hand against my lord, for He is the LORD's anointed.'

verses.kjv: Moreover, my father, see, yea, see the skirt of thy robe in my hand: for in that I cut off the skirt of thy robe, and killed thee not, know thou and see that there is neither evil nor transgression in mine hand, and I have not sinned against thee; yet thou huntest my soul to take it.
verses.modern: See, my father, see the corner of Your robe in my hand. For by the fact that I cut off the corner of Your robe and did not kill You, You may know and see that there is no wrong or treason in my hands. I have not sinned against You, though You hunt my life to take it.

verses.kjv: The LORD judge between me and thee, and the LORD avenge me of thee: but mine hand shall not be upon thee.
verses.modern: May the LORD judge between me and You, may the LORD avenge me against You, but my hand shall not be against You.

verses.kjv: As saith the proverb of the ancients, Wickedness proceedeth from the wicked: but mine hand shall not be upon thee.
verses.modern: As the proverb of the ancients says, 'Out of the wicked comes wickedness.' But my hand shall not be against you.

verses.kjv: After whom is the king of Israel come out? after whom dost thou pursue? after a dead dog, after a flea.
verses.modern: After whom has the king of Israel come out? After whom do you pursue? After a dead dog! After a flea!

verses.kjv: The LORD therefore be judge, and judge between me and thee, and see, and plead my cause, and deliver me out of thine hand.
verses.modern: May the LORD therefore be judge and give sentence between me and You, and see to it and plead my cause and deliver me from Your hand."

verses.kjv: And it came to pass, when David had made an end of speaking these words unto Saul, that Saul said, Is this thy voice, my son David? And Saul lifted up his voice, and wept.
verses.modern: As soon as David had finished speaking these words to Saul, Saul said, "Is this your voice, my son David?" And Saul lifted up his voice and wept.

verses.kjv: And he said to David, Thou art more righteous than I: for thou hast rewarded me good, whereas I have rewarded thee evil.
verses.modern: He said, "You are more righteous than I, for you have repaid me good, whereas I have repaid you evil.

verses.kjv: And thou hast shewed this day how that thou hast dealt well with me: forasmuch as when the LORD had delivered me into thine hand, thou killedst me not.
verses.modern: You have declared this day how You have dealt well with me, in that You did not kill me when the LORD put me into Your hands.

verses.kjv: For if a man find his enemy, will he let him go well away? wherefore the LORD reward thee good for that thou hast done unto me this day.
verses.modern: For if a man finds his enemy, will he let him go away safe? So may the LORD reward You with good for what You have done to me this day.

verses.kjv: And now, behold, I know well that thou shalt surely be king, and that the kingdom of Israel shall be established in thine hand.
verses.modern: Now, see, I know that You shall surely be king, and that the kingdom of Israel shall be established in Your hand.

verses.kjv: Swear now therefore unto me by the LORD, that thou wilt not cut off my seed after me, and that thou wilt not destroy my name out of my father's house.
verses.modern: Swear to me therefore by the LORD that You will not cut off my seed after me, and that You will not destroy my name out of my father's house."

verses.kjv: And David sware unto Saul. And Saul went home; but David and his men gat them up unto the hold.
verses.modern: David swore this to Saul. Then Saul went home, but David and his men went up to the stronghold.

chapters.summary: Saul entered a cave at En-gedi where David was hiding, and David secretly cut off a corner of Saul's robe but refused to kill the LORD's anointed. David showed the cut robe to Saul, and Saul wept, acknowledging that David would be king.

verses.kjv: And Samuel died; and all the Israelites were gathered together, and lamented him, and buried him in his house at Ramah. And David arose, and went down to the wilderness of Paran.
verses.modern: Now Samuel died. And all Israel assembled and mourned for him. They buried him in his house at Ramah. Then David rose and went down to the wilderness of Paran.

verses.kjv: And there was a man in Maon, whose possessions were in Carmel; and the man was very great, and he had three thousand sheep, and a thousand goats: and he was shearing his sheep in Carmel.
verses.modern: There was a man in Maon whose business was in Carmel. The man was very rich; he had three thousand sheep and a thousand goats. He was shearing his sheep in Carmel.

verses.kjv: Now the name of the man was Nabal; and the name of his wife Abigail: and she was a woman of good understanding, and of a beautiful countenance: but the man was churlish and evil in his doings; and he was of the house of Caleb.
verses.modern: Now the name of the man was Nabal, and the name of his wife Abigail. The woman was of good understanding and of a beautiful countenance, but the man was harsh and badly behaved. He was a Calebite.

verses.kjv: And David heard in the wilderness that Nabal did shear his sheep.
verses.modern: David heard in the wilderness that Nabal was shearing his sheep.

verses.kjv: And David sent out ten young men, and David said unto the young men, Get you up to Carmel, and go to Nabal, and greet him in my name:
verses.modern: So David sent ten young men. And David said to the young men, "Go up to Carmel, and go to Nabal and greet him in my name.

verses.kjv: And thus shall ye say to him that liveth in prosperity, Peace be both to thee, and peace be to thine house, and peace be unto all that thou hast.
verses.modern: Thus you shall greet him: 'Peace be to you, and peace be to your house, and peace be to all that you have.

verses.kjv: And now I have heard that thou hast shearers: now thy shepherds which were with us, we touched them not, neither was there ought missing unto them, all the while they were in Carmel.
verses.modern: I hear that you have shearers. Now your shepherds have been with us. We did not harm them. They missed nothing all the time they were in Carmel.

verses.kjv: Ask thy young men, and they will shew thee. Wherefore let the young men find favour in thine eyes: for we come in a good day: give, I pray thee, whatsoever cometh to thine hand unto thy servants, and to thy son David.
verses.modern: Ask your young men. They will tell you. Therefore let my young men find favor in your eyes, for we come on a good day. Please give whatever you have at hand to your servants and to your son David.' "

verses.kjv: And when David's young men came, they spake to Nabal according to all those words in the name of David, and ceased.
verses.modern: When David's young men came, they said all this to Nabal in the name of David, and then they waited.

verses.kjv: And Nabal answered David's servants, and said, Who is David? and who is the son of Jesse? there be many servants now a days that break away every man from his master.
verses.modern: Nabal answered David's servants, "Who is David? Who is the son of Jesse? There are many servants these days who are breaking away from their masters.

verses.kjv: Shall I then take my bread, and my water, and my flesh that I have killed for my shearers, and give it unto men, whom I know not whence they be?
verses.modern: Shall I take my bread and my water and my meat that I have killed for my shearers and give it to men who come from I do not know where?"

verses.kjv: So David's young men turned their way, and went again, and came and told him all those sayings.
verses.modern: So David's young men turned away and came back and told him all this.

verses.kjv: And David said unto his men, Gird ye on every man his sword. And they girded on every man his sword; and David also girded on his sword: and there went up after David about four hundred men; and two hundred abode by the stuff.
verses.modern: David said to his men, "Every man strap on his sword!" And every man strapped on his sword. David also strapped on his sword. And about four hundred men went up after David, while two hundred remained with the baggage.

verses.kjv: But one of the young men told Abigail, Nabal's wife, saying, Behold, David sent messengers out of the wilderness to salute our master; and he railed on them.
verses.modern: But one of the young men told Abigail, Nabal's wife, "See, David sent messengers out of the wilderness to greet our master. He shouted at them.

verses.kjv: But the men were very good unto us, and we were not hurt, neither missed we any thing, as long as we were conversant with them, when we were in the fields:
verses.modern: Yet the men were very good to us. We suffered no harm. We did not miss anything when we were in the fields, as long as we went with them.

verses.kjv: They were a wall unto us both by night and day, all the while we were with them keeping the sheep.
verses.modern: They were a wall to us both by night and by day, all the while we were with them keeping the sheep.

verses.kjv: Now therefore know and consider what thou wilt do; for evil is determined against our master, and against all his household: for he is such a son of Belial, that a man cannot speak to him.
verses.modern: Now therefore know this and consider what you should do, for harm is determined against our master and against all his house. He is such a worthless man that one cannot speak to him."

verses.kjv: Then Abigail made haste, and took two hundred loaves, and two bottles of wine, and five sheep ready dressed, and five measures of parched corn, and an hundred clusters of raisins, and two hundred cakes of figs, and laid them on asses.
verses.modern: Then Abigail made haste and took two hundred loaves and two skins of wine and five sheep already prepared and five seahs of parched grain and a hundred clusters of raisins and two hundred cakes of figs, and laid them on donkeys.

verses.kjv: And she said unto her servants, Go on before me; behold, I come after you. But she told not her husband Nabal.
verses.modern: She said to her young men, "Go on before me; see, I come after you." But she did not tell her husband Nabal.

verses.kjv: And it was so, as she rode on the ass, that she came down by the covert of the hill, and, behold, David and his men came down against her; and she met them.
verses.modern: As she rode on the donkey and came down under cover of the mountain, David and his men came down toward her. She met them.

verses.kjv: Now David had said, Surely in vain have I kept all that this fellow hath in the wilderness, so that nothing was missed of all that pertained unto him: and he hath requited me evil for good.
verses.modern: Now David had said, "Surely it was in vain that I guarded all that this fellow has in the wilderness, so that nothing was missed of all that belonged to him. He has returned me evil for good.

verses.kjv: So and more also do God unto the enemies of David, if I leave of all that pertain to him by the morning light any that pisseth against the wall.
verses.modern: God do so to the enemies of David and more also, if by morning I leave so much as any that pisseth against the wall of all who belong to him."

verses.kjv: And when Abigail saw David, she hasted, and lighted off the ass, and fell before David on her face, and bowed herself to the ground,
verses.modern: When Abigail saw David, she hurried and got down from the donkey and fell before David on her face and bowed to the ground.

verses.kjv: And fell at his feet, and said, Upon me, my lord, upon me let this iniquity be: and let thine handmaid, I pray thee, speak in thine audience, and hear the words of thine handmaid.
verses.modern: She fell at his feet and said, "On me alone, my lord, be the guilt. Please let your servant speak in your ears, and hear the words of your servant.

verses.kjv: Let not my lord, I pray thee, regard this man of Belial, even Nabal: for as his name is, so is he; Nabal is his name, and folly is with him: but I thine handmaid saw not the young men of my lord, whom thou didst send.
verses.modern: Let not my lord regard this worthless man, Nabal, for as his name is, so is he. Nabal is his name, and folly is with him. But I your servant did not see the young men of my lord, whom you sent.

verses.kjv: Now therefore, my lord, as the LORD liveth, and as thy soul liveth, seeing the LORD hath withholden thee from coming to shed blood, and from avenging thyself with thine own hand, now let thine enemies, and they that seek evil to my lord, be as Nabal.
verses.modern: Now then, my lord, as the LORD lives, and as Your soul lives, because the LORD has restrained You from bloodguilt and from saving Yourself with Your own hand, now then let Your enemies and those who seek to do evil to my lord be as Nabal.

verses.kjv: And now this blessing which thine handmaid hath brought unto my lord, let it even be given unto the young men that follow my lord.
verses.modern: Now let this present that Your servant has brought to my lord be given to the young men who follow my lord.

verses.kjv: I pray thee, forgive the trespass of thine handmaid: for the LORD will certainly make my lord a sure house; because my lord fighteth the battles of the LORD, and evil hath not been found in thee all thy days.
verses.modern: Please forgive the trespass of Your servant. For the LORD will certainly make my lord a sure house, because my lord is fighting the battles of the LORD, and evil shall not be found in You so long as You live.

verses.kjv: Yet a man is risen to pursue thee, and to seek thy soul: but the soul of my lord shall be bound in the bundle of life with the LORD thy God; and the souls of thine enemies, them shall he sling out, as out of the middle of a sling.
verses.modern: If men rise up to pursue You and to seek Your life, the life of my lord shall be bound in the bundle of the living in the care of the LORD Your God. And the lives of Your enemies He shall sling out as from the hollow of a sling.

verses.kjv: And it shall come to pass, when the LORD shall have done to my lord according to all the good that he hath spoken concerning thee, and shall have appointed thee ruler over Israel;
verses.modern: When the LORD has done to my lord according to all the good that He has spoken concerning You and has appointed You prince over Israel,

verses.kjv: That this shall be no grief unto thee, nor offence of heart unto my lord, either that thou hast shed blood causeless, or that my lord hath avenged himself: but when the LORD shall have dealt well with my lord, then remember thine handmaid.
verses.modern: My lord shall have no cause of grief or pangs of conscience for having shed blood without cause or for my lord working salvation Himself. And when the LORD has dealt well with my lord, remember Your servant."

verses.kjv: And David said to Abigail, Blessed be the LORD God of Israel, which sent thee this day to meet me:
verses.modern: David said to Abigail, "Blessed be the LORD, the God of Israel, who sent You this day to meet me!

verses.kjv: And blessed be thy advice, and blessed be thou, which hast kept me this day from coming to shed blood, and from avenging myself with mine own hand.
verses.modern: Blessed be Your discretion, and blessed be You, who have kept me this day from bloodguilt and from working salvation with my own hand!

verses.kjv: For in very deed, as the LORD God of Israel liveth, which hath kept me back from hurting thee, except thou hadst hasted and come to meet me, surely there had not been left unto Nabal by the morning light any that pisseth against the wall.
verses.modern: For as surely as the LORD, the God of Israel, lives, who has restrained me from hurting You, unless You had hurried and come to meet me, truly by morning there would not have been left to Nabal so much as any that pisseth against the wall."

verses.kjv: So David received of her hand that which she had brought him, and said unto her, Go up in peace to thine house; see, I have hearkened to thy voice, and have accepted thy person.
verses.modern: Then David received from her hand what she had brought him. And he said to her, "Go up in peace to your house. See, I have obeyed your voice. I have granted your petition."

verses.kjv: And Abigail came to Nabal; and, behold, he held a feast in his house, like the feast of a king; and Nabal's heart was merry within him, for he was very drunken: wherefore she told him nothing, less or more, until the morning light.
verses.modern: Abigail came to Nabal, and there he was holding a feast in his house, like the feast of a king. And Nabal's heart was merry within him, for he was very drunk. So she told him nothing at all until the morning light.

verses.kjv: But it came to pass in the morning, when the wine was gone out of Nabal, and his wife had told him these things, that his heart died within him, and he became as a stone.
verses.modern: In the morning, when the wine had gone out of Nabal, his wife told him these things. His heart died within him. He became like a stone.

verses.kjv: And it came to pass about ten days after, that the LORD smote Nabal, that he died.
verses.modern: About ten days later the LORD struck Nabal. He died.

verses.kjv: And when David heard that Nabal was dead, he said, Blessed be the LORD, that hath pleaded the cause of my reproach from the hand of Nabal, and hath kept his servant from evil: for the LORD hath returned the wickedness of Nabal upon his own head. And David sent and communed with Abigail, to take her to him to wife.
verses.modern: When David heard that Nabal was dead, he said, "Blessed be the LORD Who has avenged the insult I received at the hand of Nabal, and has kept back His servant from wrongdoing. The LORD has returned the evil of Nabal on His own head." Then David sent and spoke to Abigail, to take her as his wife.

verses.kjv: And when the servants of David were come to Abigail to Carmel, they spake unto her, saying, David sent us unto thee, to take thee to him to wife.
verses.modern: When the servants of David came to Abigail at Carmel, they said to her, "David has sent us to you to take you to him as his wife."

verses.kjv: And she arose, and bowed herself on her face to the earth, and said, Behold, let thine handmaid be a servant to wash the feet of the servants of my lord.
verses.modern: She rose and bowed with her face to the ground and said, "See, your servant is a servant to wash the feet of the servants of my lord."

verses.kjv: And Abigail hasted, and arose, and rode upon an ass, with five damsels of hers that went after her; and she went after the messengers of David, and became his wife.
verses.modern: Abigail hurried and rose and mounted a donkey. Her five young women attended her. She followed the messengers of David and became his wife.

verses.kjv: David also took Ahinoam of Jezreel; and they were also both of them his wives.
verses.modern: David also took Ahinoam of Jezreel, and both of them became his wives.

verses.kjv: But Saul had given Michal his daughter, David's wife, to Phalti the son of Laish, which was of Gallim.
verses.modern: Saul had given Michal his daughter, David's wife, to Palti the son of Laish, who was of Gallim.

chapters.summary: The wealthy fool Nabal refused David's request for provisions, and David set out to destroy him. Nabal's wise wife Abigail intercepted David with gifts and a plea for restraint; ten days later the LORD struck Nabal dead, and David took Abigail as his wife.

verses.kjv: And the Ziphites came unto Saul to Gibeah, saying, Doth not David hide himself in the hill of Hachilah, which is before Jeshimon?
verses.modern: Then the Ziphites came to Saul at Gibeah, saying, "Is not David hiding himself on the hill of Hachilah, which is before Jeshimon?"

verses.kjv: Then Saul arose, and went down to the wilderness of Ziph, having three thousand chosen men of Israel with him, to seek David in the wilderness of Ziph.
verses.modern: So Saul arose and went down to the wilderness of Ziph with three thousand chosen men of Israel to seek David in the wilderness of Ziph.

verses.kjv: And Saul pitched in the hill of Hachilah, which is before Jeshimon, by the way. But David abode in the wilderness, and he saw that Saul came after him into the wilderness.
verses.modern: Saul encamped on the hill of Hachilah, which is before Jeshimon, beside the road. But David remained in the wilderness. When he saw that Saul came after him into the wilderness,

verses.kjv: David therefore sent out spies, and understood that Saul was come in very deed.
verses.modern: David sent out spies and learned that Saul had indeed come.

verses.kjv: And David arose, and came to the place where Saul had pitched: and David beheld the place where Saul lay, and Abner the son of Ner, the captain of his host: and Saul lay in the trench, and the people pitched round about him.
verses.modern: Then David rose and came to the place where Saul had encamped. And David saw the place where Saul lay, with Abner the son of Ner, the commander of his army. Saul was lying within the encampment, while the army was encamped around him.
